name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 48.2 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.
There are 5 of us, including 2 children.
My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.
The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.
We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.
Room 214 is on the second floor.
I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.
What time does the museum open on Sundays?
entries.reference: 박물관은 일요일에 몇 시에 문을 엽니까?

entries.source: My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.
The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.
I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.
Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?
The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.
Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.
How much is a double room for 3 nights?
This costs 45 euros, including tax.
Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?
The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.
Can I pay the 78 euros by card?
How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?
The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.
The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.
My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.
entries.reference: 제 호텔은 그란 비아 28번지에 있고 지하철역에서 가깝습니다.

entries.source: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: 대사관은 파세오 데 라 카스테야나 259번지에 있습니다.

entries.source: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.
The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.
entries.reference: 만남의 장소는 플라사 델 솔, 3번 게이트입니다.

entries.source: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?
entries.reference: 여기가 카레르 데 발메스 112번지로 가는 길입니까?

entries.source: Where is the nearest bus stop?
Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.
Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?
Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?
Excuse me, is this seat 14A?
How do I get to the old town from here?
The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.
Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.
entries.reference: 구급차를 불러 주세요, 누군가 의식이 없습니다.

entries.source: I have lost my passport and my wallet.
Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?
I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?
entries.reference: 저는 땅콩 알레르기가 있습니다; 이 요리에 땅콩이 들어 있습니까?

entries.source: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.
entries.reference: 누군가 제 가방을 훔쳐 갔는데 안에 200유로가 있었습니다.

entries.source: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
